title: feat(#3): verified links panel
body:
## Summary
- Adds an in-session **Your Verified Links** panel on the landing page (`GET /`) between Quick Connect and the Advanced proof flow.
- After a successful **OAuth** return or **proof-post** verification, the claim is stored in a browser-only `verifiedLinks` list (deduped by `platform:identity`).
- **Publish** (per row) and **Publish All** apply identity `i` tags in a **single** kind `10011` sign-and-broadcast (same model as the existing Advanced “Publish to Nostr profile” flow).
- **Remove (×)** drops a row from the session list only (no server revoke).
- Introduces a small shared module `verified-links-logic.ts` with unit tests; adds a smoke test that the landing HTML includes the new panel elements.
- Publishes status for panel actions to `#verified-links-publish-status` so users see progress without opening Advanced; OAuth prefill of Advanced is preserved, but Advanced is no longer auto-expanded.

## Motivation
- Closes the gap between verifying multiple platforms and publishing them: users can batch verified links into one Nostr profile update instead of one publish per platform and avoid relay races from multiple sequential updates.
- Replaces the “prefill Advanced + open details” workaround with a first-class session list and explicit batch publish, while keeping the Advanced publish path for backward compatibility.

## Related Issue
- Closes https://github.com/divinevideo/divine-identify-verification-service/issues/3

## Testing
- `npm run test:once` (Vitest): all tests pass, including new `verified-links-logic` tests and landing HTML smoke test.
- **Manual (recommended):** run `npm run dev`, open `/`, connect signer, run Quick Connect for two platforms, confirm both rows in **Your Verified Links**, use **Publish All** once and confirm one signature prompt; use **×** to remove a row; full page refresh clears the list; proof-post success adds a row; Advanced **Publish to Nostr profile** still works from the form.

## API / Behavior Notes
- **None** for HTTP API routes, request/response JSON, or server-side verification rules. All changes are to the **HTML landing page and inline client script** for `GET /` (when `Accept` prefers HTML). Publishing still uses the same kind `10011` identity-event flow and relays as before; only the **client** can now merge multiple session claims into one publish.

## Sensitive Information Check
- I confirm that this PR title, description, branch name, and any screenshots I would attach use only generic product/public-repo wording and do not name partners, customers, brands, or other sensitive external identities unless explicitly approved.

title: feat(embed): postMessage NIP-07 bridge for divine.video iframe embedding
body:
## Summary

When verifyer.divine.video is loaded inside an iframe of a trusted Divine origin, install a `window.nostr` (NIP-07) shim that proxies `getPublicKey` / `signEvent` / `getRelays` calls to the parent frame over `postMessage`, and auto-trigger the existing `connectNostrSigner` flow. The host (divine-mobile Flutter web) honors the requests using the user's existing Divine session — no second login inside the embedded verifyer.

## Motivation

In the divine-mobile Flutter web app, tapping "Get verified" on the Edit Profile screen needs to open verifyer in an in-page experience (matching the integrated-apps sandbox UX on iOS / Android). Without this bridge, the iframe loads but verifyer has no way to reach the user's Divine signer — the user gets prompted to log in again, which kills the flow.

This PR is the verifyer-side half. The divine-mobile side (parent listener that handles `divine:nostr.request` and routes through `WebAuthService`) is in https://github.com/divinevideo/divine-mobile/pull/3955 (or a follow-up PR off it).

## What ships

- `src/embed-bridge.ts` — exports `EMBED_BRIDGE_SCRIPT` (the IIFE installed at the top of the page's inline `<script>`) plus `ALLOWED_PARENT_HOSTS` / `ALLOWED_PARENT_SUFFIXES`.
- `src/index.ts` — inline the bridge ahead of the signer-detection logic, and auto-call `connectNostrSigner()` on load when `window.__divineEmbedded` is set so embedded users skip the manual "Connect Nostr signer" click.
- `src/embed-bridge.test.ts` — 16 unit tests covering install gating and the postMessage protocol.

## Trust model

The shim is only installed when **both**:

1. `window.parent !== window` (we're framed), AND
2. `document.referrer`'s host matches one of:
   - `divine.video`, `app.divine.video`, `localhost` (exact)
   - `.divine.video`, `.pages.dev` (suffix — covers staging, POC, Cloudflare Pages previews)

Inbound `message` events are pinned to the captured parent origin. Outbound `postMessage` uses an explicit `targetOrigin`, never `*`. Each request gets a unique correlation id; replies with mismatched id or unexpected origin are ignored. A 60s timeout rejects the request if the parent never responds, so a silent or hostile parent can't leak the in-flight call.

## Backwards compatibility

Top-level loads (non-framed) of verifyer.divine.video are unaffected — the shim isn't installed and the existing extension / NIP-46-bunker login paths continue to work. `window.nostr` from a real browser extension is only overridden inside the trusted-parent iframe context, where the user explicitly chose to use Divine's session.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run test:once` — 117 tests pass (16 new for embed-bridge, 101 existing)
- [ ] Manual: deploy to a preview environment, embed in a test page on a `*.pages.dev` host, verify `window.nostr.signEvent` round-trips through the parent
- [ ] Manual: load verifyer.divine.video directly in a top-level tab, confirm extension/NIP-46 login still works as before
- [ ] Coordinate divine-mobile parent-side listener (PR #3955 follow-up) for end-to-end testing

title: feat: verification removal + kind 10011 migration
body:
## Summary

Add the ability for users to unlink external identity verifications from their Nostr profile via the verifyer UI, and migrate the service from kind 0 to kind 10011 (NIP-39 spec alignment).

- **Slice 0:** Migrate publish/read flows from kind 0 to kind 10011. Dual-read for backwards compat.
- **Slice 1:** Backend `POST /auth/oauth/revoke` endpoint to clear OAuth verification cache.
- **Slice 2:** Frontend manage/remove UI with confirmation flow.
- **Slice 3:** Hardening and polish.

## Context

- divine-web already implements NIP-39 removal via kind 10011 (landed Mar 1)
- The verifier currently writes to kind 0 (pre-spec), making identity claims invisible to divine-web
- This PR fixes that disconnect and adds the OAuth cache revoke that only the verifier can do
- No batch migration needed. Users migrate organically on next add/remove action.
- Bluesky AT Protocol record cleanup is deferred; this PR does not persist the credentials needed to delete that record later.

## Spec

See `docs/verification-removal-plan.md` (updated in first commit).

## Test plan

- [ ] TDD: tests written before implementation for each slice
- [ ] Verify publish emits kind 10011 (not kind 0)
- [ ] Verify lookup reads from both kind 10011 and kind 0
- [ ] Verify kind 10011 takes precedence when both exist
- [ ] Verify `POST /auth/oauth/revoke` validates NIP-98 auth
- [ ] Verify revoke is idempotent (missing key returns success)
- [ ] Verify removal publishes updated kind 10011 event
- [ ] E2E: link via UI, confirm in manage section, remove, confirm gone

title: fix: Bluesky OAuth DPoP nonce retry and client metadata
body:
## Summary

- Add DPoP nonce retry to the PAR (Pushed Authorization Request) in `startBlueskyOAuth`. AT Protocol OAuth requires a nonce exchange on the PAR endpoint. The auth server rejects the first request with `use_dpop_nonce` and a `DPoP-Nonce` header; the client must retry with the nonce in the DPoP proof. This was already implemented for the token exchange in `handleBlueskyCallback` but was missing from the PAR request.
- Fix `client_uri` in Bluesky client metadata to use `OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE` instead of hardcoded `divine.video`. Bluesky's auth server requires `client_uri` and `client_id` to share the same origin.
- Add error detail logging to PAR failures (status code + response body in both `console.error` and the JSON response).

Also sets `OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE` secret on the worker (done out-of-band via `wrangler secret put`).

## Test plan

- [x] 70/70 vitest tests pass (5 new OAuth tests covering nonce retry, no-retry success, failure without nonce, failure after retry, missing config)
- [x] `wrangler deploy --dry-run` builds clean
- [x] Deployed to production, tested Bluesky Quick Connect end-to-end on verifier.divine.video
- [x] Existing proof-post verification unaffected

title: Add YouTube and TikTok verification (NIP-39) with OAuth
body:
## Summary
- Add YouTube verification via YouTube Data API v3 (checks video description for npub)
- Add TikTok verification via public oEmbed API (checks video caption for npub, no API key needed)
- Add OAuth login flows for both platforms as an alternative to proof posts
- Update landing page, API docs, and all platform registries
- 18 new tests (59 total passing)

## NIP-39 Tag Formats
```
["i", "youtube:CHANNEL_ID", "VIDEO_ID"]
["i", "tiktok:USERNAME", "VIDEO_ID"]
```

## Secrets Required Before Deploying

⚠️ **YouTube proof-post verification will be disabled until `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` is set.** It returns a clear "YouTube API key not configured" error. TikTok proof-post verification works immediately (oEmbed is public, no key needed).

OAuth flows for both platforms will return 503 until their respective secrets are configured:

```
wrangler secret put YOUTUBE_API_KEY
wrangler secret put GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
wrangler secret put GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
wrangler secret put TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY
wrangler secret put TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET
```

## Graceful Degradation
- **YouTube verifier**: Returns `"YouTube API key not configured"` error when `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` is missing — all other platforms unaffected
- **TikTok verifier**: Works immediately with no keys (uses public oEmbed endpoint)
- **YouTube OAuth**: Returns 503 when `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is missing
- **TikTok OAuth**: Returns 503 when `TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY` is missing
- **Existing platforms**: Completely unaffected — no changes to their verification logic

## Test plan
- [x] `npm test` — 59 tests passing (18 new)
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean compile
- [ ] Set YouTube API key and test with a real YouTube video containing npub in description
- [ ] Test TikTok verification with a real TikTok video containing npub in caption
- [ ] Set Google OAuth credentials and test YouTube OAuth flow
- [ ] Set TikTok OAuth credentials and test TikTok OAuth flow
- [ ] Deploy: `npx wrangler deploy`
